text: 金十数据11月12日讯，受美国通胀数据高于预期及美联储官员鹰派表态影响，市场进一步强化对美联储12月加息的预期，黄金一度下跌0.8%，跌破4000美元/盎司，美元则升至2025年4月以来最高水平。目前市场已完全计入12月加息25个基点的预期，并开始计入小幅概率的50个基点加息。利率上升提高了持有无息黄金的机会成本，美元走强也增加了其他货币投资者的购金成本。尽管短期承压，黄金大部分时间仍守在4000美元上方，显示该价位获得一定买盘支撑，央行购金需求也保持稳定。渣打银行大宗商品研究主管Suki Cooper表示，尽管股市出现调整，黄金价格仍表现坚挺，显示其避
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 12 - Affected by US inflation data coming in above expectations and hawkish remarks from Fed officials, the market further strengthened expectations for a Fed rate hike in December; gold at one point fell 0.8% and dropped below $4,000/oz, while the dollar rose to its highest level since April 2025. The market has now fully priced in a 25-basis-point hike in December and has begun pricing in a small probability of a 50-basis-point hike. Rising interest rates increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold, and a stronger dollar also raises the cost of buying gold for investors in other currencies. Despite short-term pressure, gold mostly held above $4,000, indicating some buying support at that level, and central bank gold demand has remained stable.
